dialogues.speaker: Futuh
dialogues.text: Oh, I didn't mean that I actually plan to return to that lousy desert, I meant Aaru Village on the desert's border.

dialogues.speaker: Futuh
dialogues.text: I heard from the village elders that Aaru Village used to be a part of King Deshret's Citadel! How amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Futuh
dialogues.text: If you think about it, Aaru Village may be in the desert, but life is pretty nice there. You don't have to endure wet weather, and you can go shopping at Caravan Ribat too.

dialogues.speaker: Futuh
dialogues.text: You probably won't make much money there, but you'll find everything else in that place pretty neat.
